sentences.text: Nemegtonykus is a genus containing only one known species, Nemegtonykus citus. It belongs to the alvarezsaurid family of dinosaurs.
This animal is placed within the subfamily Parvicursorinae.
It is the second alvarezsaurid discovered in the Nemegt Formation, after Mononykus.
Lee Sungjin and colleagues named this species in 2019.
The name mixes the Nemegt Formation with a Greek word for claw, while the species name means the fast one in Latin.
The holotype specimen MPC-D 100/203 comes from a layer dating to perhaps the late Campanian or early Maastrichtian.
Nemegtonykus lived between 75 and 71 million years ago, specifically during the Maastrichtian stage from 72.2 to 66 million years ago, in what is now Asia.
